tasks.title: Remove dead filteredProfiles plumbing from CredentialDashboard.vue
tasks.spec: In components/CredentialDashboard.vue, remove the unused `filteredProfiles` ref (around line 95) and the watch that emits `filtered-profiles` (around lines 139-141). Confirmed dead: no template control writes to `filteredProfiles`, and no parent component listens for `filtered-profiles`. Search the whole repo for `filteredProfiles` and `filtered-profiles` before removing to confirm zero remaining references, then delete. Do not touch the unrelated `search`/`filteredCredentials` filter -- that one is live and stays. Behavior-preserving cleanup; no test change expected. Run the existing CredentialDashboard test suite (if one exists) and confirm it's unaffected.
tasks.note: CANCELLED -- the spec was factually wrong, not the agent. It asserted "no parent component listens for filtered-profiles"; HomePage.vue does listen (@filtered-profiles="filteredProfiles = $event") and uses it to drive shownProfiles, which gates credential fetching. The agent verified this and correctly refused to delete live code. filteredProfiles is NOT dead code -- it is only unwritten within CredentialDashboard.vue itself.

tasks.title: Write tests: lifted credential-details dialog in CredentialDashboard.vue
tasks.spec: Write failing tests (they should fail against today's CredentialDashboard.vue, which has no dialog of its own) asserting: (1) CredentialDashboard.vue renders exactly one <credential-details> dialog instance, gated by a `showDetails` ref, initially closed; (2) emitting a `select` event with a credential object from a child component (mock CredentialsList or CredentialListRow stub) sets `showDetails` to true and passes that credential into the dialog's `credential` prop; (3) closing the dialog (v-model false) resets it so a different row's `select` can reopen it with a new credential. Reference CredentialCardBundle.vue's existing `<q-dialog v-model="showDetails">` + `<credential-details>` markup (around lines 37-52) as the pattern being lifted -- same dialog composition, different owner. Use the same test-utils/mounting setup as existing specs in this repo (check for a sibling *.spec.js next to CredentialCardBundle.vue for the harness pattern -- Quasar plugin install, etc.).

tasks.title: Lift credential-details dialog to CredentialDashboard.vue
tasks.spec: Add `selectedCredential` (ref, null) and `showDetails` (ref, false) to CredentialDashboard.vue. Render a single `<q-dialog v-model="showDetails">` wrapping `<credential-details :credential="selectedCredential" ...>` at the dashboard level (copy the dialog-composition pattern from CredentialCardBundle.vue lines ~37-52, including whatever other props CredentialDetails.vue requires -- check its props definition). Add a handler `onSelect(credential)` that sets `selectedCredential.value = credential` and `showDetails.value = true`; wire it to listen for a `select` event from CredentialsList (the emit itself is wired in W05 -- for now this task just needs the listener present and functional against the T02 test harness's mock emit). This is the interface seam Benjamin's router work will later swap `showDetails.value = true` for a `router.push` -- leave `onSelect` as a single clearly-named function so that swap is a one-line change later, not an architecture change. Run T02's test file; all assertions must pass before committing.
tasks.note: Marked failed by the orchestrator for a missing completion marker, but the work is committed (12ee27e) and verified present: showDetails / selectedCredential / onSelect exist and are returned from setup(), and the single lifted <credential-details> dialog renders in CredentialDashboard.vue. All 6 T02 tests pass per its own log.

tasks.title: Write tests: category chip band derivation + filtering
tasks.spec: Write failing tests asserting: (1) a `credentialCategories` computed derives the distinct set of credential types actually present in the current credential list (auto-generated, not a hardcoded list) -- feed it a mock list with 3 credentials of 2 distinct types and assert exactly those 2 categories appear, no duplicates; (2) setting `activeCategory` to one of those types filters the rendered list to only that type; (3) `activeCategory` set to null/'all' shows everything; (4) the category filter composes with the existing `search` text filter (both active -- result is the intersection, not either alone). Use the same mock-credential shape existing specs in this repo already use (check CredentialDashboard's current filteredCredentials test if one exists, otherwise use the same credential fixture shape as CredentialCardBundle's specs).

tasks.title: Implement category chip band
tasks.spec: Add an `activeCategory` ref (default null/'all') and a `credentialCategories` computed deriving the distinct credential types present in the current list. Render a `matchMedia`-scoped (mobile only, matching the PR #137 breakpoint pattern -- do not use `$q.screen`) horizontally-scrollable chip/tab band above the list (Quasar `q-tabs`/`q-chip`, whichever composes more simply with the existing search box in the same header row). Combine `activeCategory` with the existing `filteredCredentials` computed (search text AND category, not OR). No animation. Run T03's test file; all assertions must pass before committing.

tasks.title: Write tests: CredentialListRow.vue
tasks.spec: Write failing tests for a not-yet-created CredentialListRow.vue asserting: (1) given a credential whose cardDesigns entry matches, it renders an icon, a title, and at most 2 highlight fields even when the matched cardDesigns entry defines more than 2 `highlights` (truncation, not a layout overflow); (2) given a credential with a cardDesigns match that defines fewer than 2 highlights, it renders however many exist (0, 1, or 2) without erroring on missing data; (3) given a credential with NO matching cardDesigns entry, it still renders icon+title with no highlight fields, not a blank/broken row (mirrors the 'design for the minimum' requirement -- every credential type is guaranteed at most icon+title+2 fields, never assumes more); (4) clicking the row emits a `select` event with the credential object. Model the cardDesigns-matching test fixtures on CredentialCardBundle.vue's existing specs (same getCredentialConfig()-driven matching logic is being reused here via a shared composable -- see V04).

tasks.title: Implement CredentialListRow.vue + extract shared cardDesigns composable
tasks.spec: Extract CredentialCardBundle.vue's `getCredentialConfig()` + the styles/overrides/highlights derivation (the watch on `props.credentialRecord?.credential` added on the current db-732 branch, with `{immediate: true}`) into a shared composable `lib/useCredentialCardConfig.js`, taking a credential ref and returning {styles, overrides, highlights}. Update CredentialCardBundle.vue to consume the composable instead of its inline copy (no behavior change -- this is a pure extraction, desktop rendering must be identical before/after). Create CredentialListRow.vue using the same composable: render an icon (from `overrides.imagePointer` resolution, same as CredentialCardBundle), a title (`overrides.title`), and at most the first 2 entries of `highlights` (slice, not all of them). Emit `select` with the full credential on click. No animation, no flip, no back-of-card -- front-only per the PRD. Run T04's test file; all assertions must pass before committing. Also re-run CredentialCardBundle.vue's existing spec file to confirm the extraction didn't change its behavior.

tasks.title: Write tests: CredentialsList.vue matchMedia branch
tasks.spec: Write failing tests asserting: (1) with matchMedia mocked to mobile width (reuse whatever matchMedia-mocking helper the db-732 branch's CredentialDetails/CredentialCardBundle specs already use -- find and reuse it, don't reinvent), CredentialsList.vue renders CredentialListRow per item, not CredentialCardBundle; (2) at desktop width, it renders CredentialCardBundle per item, unchanged from today; (3) a `select` event emitted by a rendered CredentialListRow (mobile) is re-emitted upward by CredentialsList.vue with the same credential payload.

tasks.title: Wire CredentialsList.vue breakpoint branch + select bubbling
tasks.spec:
In CredentialsList.vue's v-for (around lines 56-69), branch on the same matchMedia check used elsewhere in this pass: mobile renders <credential-list-row> per item, desktop keeps <credential-card-bundle> unchanged. Bubble each row's `select` event up through CredentialsList.vue to CredentialDashboard.vue, where it reaches the `onSelect` handler added in V02. Run T05's test file; all assertions must pass before committing.

tasks.title: Replace manual refresh with pull-to-refresh on mobile
tasks.spec: On mobile matchMedia width only, remove the manual refresh button (`fas fa-sync-alt`, lines ~21-27) and wrap the list in Quasar's `q-pull-to-refresh` (confirm it's available in the installed Quasar version -- check package.json/@bedrock/quasar; if unavailable, implement a minimal touch-based pull handler instead).
